protocol_joint_sequence: br.reset_state(): v, g, adaptation, refractory and delay buffers reset; weights kept
probe_naive: odour A then B at 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 x 150 Hz, 1000 ms each, 500 ms gaps (arena baseline only)
train (once, eta 0.6): Odor A + PAM (1 s), 2 s gap, odor B (1 s), 2 s gap; then KC->MBON depression.
memory test: odour A 1000 ms, gap 1000 ms, odour B 1000 ms (V_post)
arena 120 s with 10 threats (reset_state at arena start: True)

Caveat: a jump is counted at any take-off, not only during a threat. house_nb.py takes off whenever the fly is grounded, the giant fibre spikes summed over BOTH DNp01 neurons in the last 30 ms (three 10-ms body steps) reach 2, and more than 1 s has passed since the last jump. A threat window lasts 0.6 s and threat onsets are at least 10.1 s apart, so at most one jump fits in the window of a threat met; every jump beyond the number of threats met is a take-off outside those windows, and a jump inside a window need not be a response to it. Jumps per threat is therefore not escape success.

_meaning.arena_constants: Arena constants from code: [shadow (threat) duration s (house.py Arena.shadow_dur), jump refractory s (house_nb.py), giant fibre spikes needed for take-off, summed over BOTH giant fibres (DNp01 left and right share out_id 1 in house_nb.py) (house.py Body.gf_spikes), take-off window ms = the last three 10-ms body steps (house_nb.py gf_sp), MN9 feeding threshold Hz (Body.feed_hz)]. The take-off test does not depend on a threat being present. Caveat: a jump is counted at any take-off, not only during a threat. house_nb.py takes off whenever the fly is grounded, the giant fibre spikes summed over BOTH DNp01 neurons in the last 30 ms (three 10-ms body steps) reach 2, and more than 1 s has passed since the last jump. A threat window lasts 0.6 s and threat onsets are at least 10.1 s apart, so at most one jump fits in the window of a threat met; every jump beyond the number of threats met is a take-off outside those windows, and a jump inside a window need not be a response to it. Jumps per threat is therefore not escape success.
_meaning.arena_max_jumps_per_threat_window: Maximum number of take-offs possible during one threat window, given the 0.6 s shadow duration and the 1 s jump refractory period.
